title: Parades with two bands; the Hot Goblins; Willie Parker
summary: Glass says parades had two bands and he belonged to the Hot Goblins, and Willie Parker played bass drum.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did they have more than one band ever in parades in those times?
No, they had that one band.
When they have a big band, a big parade, how many bands would they have though?

Two bands. You remember Hot Goblins and them like that. They'd have two bands. Who did they hire? Well I wouldn't know all the fellas in the band. You don't know the names of the bands? Because I used to belong to the Hot Goblins and things like that. Yeah, I belonged to the Hot Goblins and the Hot fellas and things. But I wasn't too much of interest in playing with them, you know? Because they had all their own bands, all the older bands in our work. Willie Parker?
I guess Willie Parker was in there.
Yeah, Willie Parker was in there.
